items.title: Oracle (ORCL) Stock Looks Undervalued On Earnings While Risks Still Weigh
items.summary: Oracle stock has dropped sharply over the past year, yet valuation checks still lean in its favour, which puts the recent share price weakness at odds with what the broader metrics suggest about value. Oracle shares have fallen 51.5% over the past year, which means the market has sharply reset expectations despite the company remaining a major player in cloud and enterprise software.
